mapper.select: SELECT id::text AS id, username, password_hash, enabled FROM workspace.app_user WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT id::text AS id, username, password_hash, enabled FROM workspace.app_user WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace.app_user(id, username, password_hash, enabled) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, TRUE) ON CONFLICT (username) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT w.id::text AS id, w.name, m.role, w.revision, w.created_at, w.updated_at FROM workspace.workspace w INNER JOIN workspace.membership m ON m.workspace_id = w.id INNER JOIN workspace.app_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.user_id = #{actorId} AND u.enabled = TRUE AND w.archived_at IS NULL AND (w.created_at, w.id) > (#{cursorTime}, #{cursorId}) ORDER BY w.created_at, w.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT w.id::text AS id, w.name, m.role, w.revision, w.created_at, w.updated_at FROM workspace.workspace w INNER JOIN workspace.membership m ON m.workspace_id = w.id INNER JOIN workspace.app_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE w.id = #{workspaceId} AND m.user_id = #{actorId} AND u.enabled = TRUE AND w.archived_at IS NULL

SELECT m.role FROM workspace.membership m INNER JOIN workspace.workspace w ON w.id = m.workspace_id INNER JOIN workspace.app_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND m.user_id = #{actorId} AND u.enabled = TRUE AND w.archived_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace.workspace(id, name, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{actorId})
INSERT INTO workspace.membership(workspace_id, user_id, role) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{actorId}, 'ADMIN')
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace.workspace SET name = #{name}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{workspaceId} AND revision = #{expectedRevision} AND archived_at IS NULL

UPDATE workspace.workspace SET archived_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, revision = revision + 1 WHERE id = #{workspaceId} AND revision = #{expectedRevision} AND archived_at IS NULL
